{{Short description|Chemist}}
'''Carlton Grant Willson''' is a professor at the [[University of Texas at Austin]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=C. Grant Willson |url=https://www.che.utexas.edu/people/faculty/willson |access-date=2024-05-04 |website=www.che.utexas.edu}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
He received his B.S. in [[chemistry]] from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1962, an M.S. in [[organic chemistry]] from [[San Diego State University]] in 1969, and a [[Ph.D.]] in organic chemistry from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1973.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />

==Career==
Prior to joining the University of Texas in 1993, Willson worked as an IBM Fellow and Manager of Polymer Science and Technology at the IBM Almaden Research Center in [[San Jose, California]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Willson Research Group - C. Grant Willson Bio |url=https://willson.cm.utexas.edu/Willson/bio.php |access-date=2024-05-04 |website=willson.cm.utexas.edu}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Professor C. Grant Willson |url=https://nae.edu/221038/Professor-C-Grant-Willson |access-date=2024-05-04 |website=NAE Website |language=en}}</ref> He also has held faculty positions at the [[California State University, Long Beach]], and the [[University of California, San Diego]].<ref name=":0" />

==Research==
Willson's research focuses on the design and synthesis of functional organic materials, with a particular emphasis on microelectronics applications. This includes work on liquid crystalline materials, polymeric non-linear optical materials, and novel photoresist materials.<ref name=":0" />

==Selected publications==
* Frechet, J. M. J. Ito, H. Willson, C. G. Sensitive Deep UV Resist Incorporating Chemical Amplification. Proceedings Microcircuit Engineering 1982, Grenoble, 260.
* Willson, C. Grant; Ito, Hiroshi; Frechet, J. M. J. “L'amplification chimique appliquee au developpement de polymeres utilisables comme resines de lithographie,” Colloque Internationale sur la Microlithographie: Microcircuit Engineering 82 261 (1982)
* Willson, C. Grant; Ito, Hiroshi; Frechet, Jean M. J.; Houlihan, Frank. “Chemical Amplification in the Design of Polymers for Resist Applications,” International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry 28 448 (1982)
* Willson, Grant C.; Ito, Hiroshi; Frechet, Jean M. J.; Tessier, Theodore G.; Houlihan, Francis M. “Approaches to the Design of Radiation-Sensitive Polymeric Imaging Systems with Improved Sensitivity and Resolution,” J.Elecrochem.Soc. 133(1) 181-187 (1986)
* MacDonald, Scott A.; Willson, C. Grant; Frechet, Jean M. J. “Chemical Amplification in High-Resolution Imaging Systems,” Accounts of Chemical Research 27(6) 151-158 (1994)
